findings.description: Re-verified ledger [33]: finish() still writes RunRecord.vendors=list(cfg.vendors) even after effective_vendors() filters the allowlist to vendors that appear in the suite. Config vendors with no planned pairs are recorded as if they ran; results latest/trend and the runbook's which-vendors-ran question stay misleading.

Re-verified ledger [34]: CLIVendorExecutor always calls install_gh_shim(..., origin_path_for(workdir)) even when fixture.local_remote is false. State points origin at a bare repo that was never created; gh pr create/merge then fail inside the shim with opaque git errors and do not append gh-unsupported.log, so the pair becomes a vendor error instead of the designed gh shim: unsupported call message.

findings.description: Re-verified ledger [37]: install_gh_shim still writes shebang f"#!{sys.executable}\n". Linux shebangs cannot contain spaces; a venv under a path with spaces makes every gh invocation fail with ENOENT-style errors rather than the unsupported-call path. Lower likelihood on the fixed-path nightly host.

Re-verified ledger [38]: skills_sha() still uses repo-wide git status --porcelain, so any uncommitted file outside skills/ marks +dirty. Matches current spec wording but makes skills_sha noisy for trend consumers on a dirty checkout. Scoping porcelain to the skills directory would match reader expectations.

Operators can set judge.enabled: true and still get only trajectory_status: skip with no warning that judging was not activated.

findings.description: New: resolve_agent_id() returns IMPROVE_HARNESS_AGENT_ID verbatim (including commas), while resolve_agent_ids() splits on commas and query_memory loops those ids. build_memory_query() uses resolve_agent_id, so with the runbook's documented comma-separated IMPROVE_HARNESS_AGENT_ID=improve-harness,agent-scenarios-nightly a direct build_memory_query() payload carries agent_id="improve-harness,agent-scenarios-nightly", which the coordinator exact-match filter will not return. query_memory itself is fine; the public MemoryQueryRequest helper and any caller that trusts its agent_id field are not.
